posts.title: Keeping up with docs reviews: Building a tracker for Mautic's documentation PRs
posts.description: I was the sole maintainer reviewing Mautic's docs PRs, and reviewing wasn't the hard part. Keeping track of reminders, escalations, and backports across every PR became a full job on its own, so I built a tool to do it for me.

posts.title: How Mautic pairs Promptless with human review to catch up on docs
posts.description: Mautic's documentation fell behind by entire release versions, until we paired Promptless, an AI tool to update docs, with human review to close the gap. I share how the workflow works, why human review still matters, and how much faster docs move now.

posts.title: Wanted: Beginners-friendly open source projects
posts.description: Someone wanted to start contributing to open source but couldn't find good beginner-friendly issues on GitHub. An open call for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or Next.js projects that welcome new contributors.
